title: Undergraduate Academic Calendar 2026/2027
text:
Refund of Fees
Credit
balances in
student
accounts, which result from awards, adjustments, and/or withdrawals during a
term
, will be held for application towards the next term's fees, unless the student submits a request for a refund through LORIS.
Financial Aid/OSAP Applicants:
Refunds of credits resulting from OSAP/Loans are subject to approval by the Financial Aid Office and may be returned to the National Student Loans Centre in the event of identified over-payments.
International Students:
Credits resulting from international payments are required to remain on the student account for application towards the next term's fees and are not eligible for any domestic refunding.
Refund processing dates and other policies and procedures can be found on the Refunding
webpage
.
